import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        int to;
        int rev;
        int cap;
        int w;

        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int w) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] g;
    static int[] vis, cur, dis, pot;
    static int n;

    static int addv(int c) {
        while (c-- > 0) {
            g[n++] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        return n - 1;
    }

    static void adde(int u, int v, int c, int w) {
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, g[v].size(), c, w));
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, g[u].size() - 1, 0, -w));
    }

    static boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        PriorityQueue<int[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
        q.offer(new int[]{dis[s] = 0, s});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] top = q.poll();
            int du = top[0], u = top[1];
            if (vis[u] == 1) continue;
            vis[u] = 1;
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                int v = e.to;
                int dv = du + pot[u] + e.w - pot[v];
                if (e.cap == 0 || vis[v] == 1 || dis[v] <= dv) continue;
                q.offer(new int[]{dis[v] = dv, v});
            }
        }
        return vis[t] == 1;
    }

    static boolean dinic_bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        vis[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                int v = e.to;
                if (vis[v] == 1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                vis[v] = vis[u] + 1;
                q.offer(v);
            }
        }
        return vis[t] == 1;
    }

    static int dinic_dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        int sf = 0;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i) {
            cur[u] = i;
            Edge e = g[u].get(i);
            int v = e.to;
            if (e.cap == 0 || vis[v] != vis[u] + 1) continue;
            if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
            int df = dinic_dfs(v, t, Math.min(e.cap, f));
            sf += df;
            f -= df;
            e.cap -= df;
            g[v].get(e.rev).cap += df;
            if (f == 0) break;
        }
        return sf;
    }

    static class MCMFResult {
        int flow;
        int cost;

        MCMFResult(int flow, int cost) {
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static MCMFResult mcmf(int s, int t, int mf) {
        int sf = 0, sc = 0;
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            int f = 0;
            while (dinic_bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                int df = dinic_dfs(s, t, mf);
                mf -= df;
                f += df;
                if (mf == 0) break;
            }
            sf += f;
            sc += (dis[t] + pot[t]) * f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) pot[i] += dis[i];
            if (mf == 0) break;
        }
        return new MCMFResult(sf, sc);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n_in = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int layers = Math.max(n_in, k) * 2;
        g = new List[layers * n_in + 2];
        n = 0;
        addv(layers * n_in);
        int s = addv(1);
        int t = addv(1);
        dis = new int[10001];
        pot = new int[10001];
        vis = new int[10001];
        cur = new int[10001];

        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            --a;
            adde(s, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            --u; --v;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n_in, v1 = v + (i + 1) * n_in;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n_in, v2 = v + i * n_in;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    adde(u1, v1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    adde(v2, u2, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < layers; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n_in; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n_in, v = j + (i + 1) * n_in;
                adde(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < layers; ++i)
            adde(i * n_in, t, INF, 0);
        System.out.println(mcmf(s, t, INF).cost);
    }
}
